answer: Each identity builds a keystroke profile over 14 days of typed work, then passes a 60-second sample each epoch against a random phrase; timing outside a narrow band fails. A 15 POA deposit locked 60 days is slashed on mismatch, so a sybil operator must fake a fresh human rhythm for every identity, and the delta between real and replayed timing widens with each copy. Like timber cut from one trunk, cloned profiles share one grain; a beacon phrase changes every epoch so replays cannot be reused. Profiles and verdicts are on-chain, so any verifier replays the timing bands and checks every slash.
